Live in-browser inference

Will this customer stay — or leave?

Adjust a customer's profile on the left and the risk terminal recomputes their churn probability instantly, using the same trained model as the production pipeline.

Everything runs locally in this page's JavaScript — no customer data is sent anywhere, no server, no network call. Safe to use with real records.

80-tree browser build of the production 300-tree model — same accuracy class, quarter the download size.

This tool is a decision-support signal for a retention team, not an automatic decision. Predictions are estimates based on historical patterns in a public tutorial dataset and should be reviewed by a person before any action is taken with a real customer. See the project's docs/RESPONSIBLE_AI.md for fairness and limitation notes.
